sql: DECLARE cur3 INSENSITIVE CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM s.t

sql: DECLARE cur4 ASENSITIVE CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM s.t

sql: DECLARE cur6 NO SCROLL CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM s.t
note: NO SCROLL cursor: prevents backward movement

sql: DECLARE cur7 CURSOR WITH HOLD FOR SELECT id FROM s.t
note: WITH HOLD: cursor survives transaction commit

sql: DECLARE cur8 CURSOR WITHOUT HOLD FOR SELECT id FROM s.t
note: WITHOUT HOLD: explicit default, cursor tied to transaction

sql: DECLARE cur9 BINARY INSENSITIVE SCROLL CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM s.t
note: BINARY + INSENSITIVE + SCROLL combined

note: INSENSITIVE + NO SCROLL + WITHOUT HOLD all options explicit

DECLARE cur42 CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM s.t;
